categories.main_business_segments: MSCI operates in four reportable segments: Index, Analytics, ESG and Climate, and All Other – Private Assets. The Index segment provides equity and fixed income indexes used for benchmarking, portfolio construction, and as the basis for investment products. The Analytics segment offers risk management, performance attribution, and portfolio management tools. The ESG and Climate segment delivers data, ratings, and research to help investors integrate environmental, social, and governance considerations. The All Other – Private Assets segment includes real assets and private capital data, analytics, and benchmarks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: MSCI leverages proprietary research, advanced data collection, and technology platforms, including open-architecture, web-based solutions and APIs. The company utilizes data science, machine learning, and cloud computing to process large datasets, enhance analytics, and deliver scalable, integrated solutions. Its products are developed by interdisciplinary teams of mathematicians, economists, statisticians, and financial engineers, with a focus on continuous innovation and integration across segments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MSCI serves over 6,600 clients in more than 95 countries, including asset owners (pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds), asset managers (institutional funds, mutual funds, hedge funds, ETFs), financial intermediaries (banks, broker-dealers, exchanges), wealth managers, real estate professionals, and corporates. Its tools are widely used by the global investment community for portfolio construction, risk management, ESG integration, and benchmarking.
categories.geographic_coverage: MSCI has a global footprint, with clients in over 95 countries and principal offices in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The Americas accounted for $1.03 billion of 2022 revenues, EMEA for $863 million, and Asia & Australia for $355 million. Nearly half of MSCI’s employees are based in the Asia Pacific region, reflecting its broad international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: MSCI operates as a downstream provider in the financial services supply chain, delivering data, analytics, indexes, and decision-support tools directly to institutional investors, asset managers, and other financial market participants. It aggregates and processes third-party and proprietary data to create value-added products for end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: MSCI’s strategic priorities include expanding research-enhanced content across asset classes, leading ESG and climate integration, enhancing technology platforms, enabling client customization, and deepening strategic partnerships. The company invests heavily in R&D to innovate in areas such as ESG, climate, thematics, factors, fixed income, and private assets, and regularly pursues strategic acquisitions to complement its offerings.
categories.revenue_model: MSCI generates revenue primarily through recurring subscription fees for data, analytics, and research products, as well as variable asset-based fees linked to assets under management in investment products based on its indexes. Non-recurring revenues come from one-time licenses and services. In 2022, 73.8% of revenues were from recurring subscriptions, 23.5% from asset-based fees, and 2.7% from non-recurring sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MSCI’s main competitors in indexes include S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, and Solactive. In analytics, it competes with Qontigo, BlackRock Solutions, Bloomberg, and FactSet. ESG and Climate competitors include Sustainalytics, ISS, Trucost, Refinitiv, Bloomberg, and Moody’s. For private assets, competitors provide real estate and private capital data and analytics. MSCI is recognized as a leading, research-driven provider with a strong global brand and deep client relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, MSCI reported $2.25 billion in operating revenues (up 10% year-over-year), $1.33 billion in adjusted EBITDA (59.1% margin), and $870.6 million in net income (up 19.9%). The company has demonstrated consistent growth, driven by strong recurring revenues, high retention rates (95.2% in 2022), and expanding demand for ESG, climate, and private asset solutions. Its financial model emphasizes stable cash flows and disciplined capital allocation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MSCI’s value proposition centers on delivering mission-critical, research-driven, and technology-enabled tools that help investors make better decisions in a complex, evolving investment landscape. Its differentiation lies in its integrated, client-centric approach, breadth and depth of proprietary content, leadership in ESG and climate analytics, and ability to deliver scalable, customizable solutions across asset classes and geographies.
